spellbook.finance/limitations: Accepted submission does not prove a live price. A matching readback does not resolve an unknown submission.
Missing provider observations remain unknown. This read never approves, revokes or reverses an order.

description: Read one exact eBay pricing batch's immutable targets, owner approval state and per-listing submission and readback evidence. Call after preparation or execution. Use spellbook_ebay_pricing_approval_execute only after owner approval; keep unknown submissions distinct from observed prices.

operationId.description: Exact operation ID returned by preparation. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the seller selected. The caller must own it. Required.
